content:
emma: Heads-up: after merge abc1234 the int4 packer change triggered a 25-40% median -> p95 token latency spike on long-context loads in canary. Perf CI shows dequant CPU hot path jumped. https://ci.redwood/xyz :disappointed:
raj: saw it too on dedicated nightly, reproduces locally with seq_len=2048 and batch_size=1. Flamegraphs point to `dequantize_block` and `kv_cache::lookup` thrashing.
perf-bot: CI perf regression detected on branch main. +35% p95 tokens for model/redwood-4q on ci/runner-42. Artifact: https://ci.redwood/artifacts/180234/dom-flame.svg
sophie: Can you paste the quick perf command you ran?
emma: `python perf/run_latency.py --model redwood-4q --seq 2048 --batch 1 --profile=flame` then open artifact. Also ran `perf record -g -- python perf/run_latency.py ...` and attached samples.
raj: quick diff shows packer change (abc1234) modified memcpy alignment and removed a small-path that avoided copy for cached kv blocks. Suspect extra memcpy + dequant per attention head.
emma: profiler snippet:
```
 34.2%  dequantize_block
 18.5%  memcpy
 12.0%  kv_cache::lookup
 8.1%   attention_forward
```
sophie: if memcpy is the issue we could try reverting the alignment change in the packer, or short-circuiting for cached blocks (skip pack/unpack when KV hit).
raj: I'll start a bisect across commits {abc1200..abc1240} tonight. tagging @ops for canary hold.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy for main paused due to perf alert. ID: canary-2026-03-18-07
emma: temporary mitigation: set `KV_CACHE_PREFETCH=false` in canary to avoid thrash; reduces p95 by ~12% in local testing.
sophie: good. If bisect points to packer, we should revert + add a CI perf test that simulates seq=2048 cache-hit path and measures dequant overhead.
emma: plan: raj -> bisect and minimal repro, sophie -> prepare revert PR if confirmed, emma -> add CI perf test + perf gating. ETA: EOD PST.
raj: starting bisect now, will post commit range and minimal repro (docker image + script) when available.
perf-bot: bisect job queued: ci/bisect-180234/1
emma: thanks all :thumbsup:
